title.zh: 纽约起诉 Polymarket 涉嫌无牌赌博运营 - CryptoRank
title.en: New York Sues Polymarket Over Unlicensed Gambling Operation - CryptoRank

current_state.zh:
纽约州总检察长 Letitia James 与州长 Kathy Hochul 对 Polymarket US 提起诉讼，指控该加密预测市场在纽约州内运营非法的无牌赌博业务。Polymarket 回应称其市场属于受美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）联邦监管的事件合约，并指出公司已收购一家持有 CFTC 牌照的机构、员工超过 350 人。

据 CryptoRank 报道，此案加大了加密预测市场的监管风险，可能影响其用户采用、融资、代币与市场流动性。同时，它也加剧了事件合约究竟适用联邦衍生品规则还是州级赌博法的管辖权之争。

Polymarket 近期推出了最高 20 倍杠杆的永续合约交易。纽约州此前已于 7 月以类似理由起诉 Polymarket 的竞争对手 Kalshi，并在 4 月起诉 Coinbase 和 Gemini，指其在未取得州赌博牌照的情况下运营预测市场平台。
current_state.en: New York has filed suit against Polymarket, alleging the crypto prediction market operates as an unlicensed gambling business.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: New York has filed suit against Polymarket, alleging the crypto prediction market operates as an unlicensed gambling business.
updates.detailed_summary_en: New York has filed suit against Polymarket, alleging the crypto prediction market operates as an unlicensed gambling business.
updates.background_zh: CFTC 主张其对该不断壮大的预测市场行业拥有专属监管权，而非由各州分别监管。Polymarket 同时运营国际平台和面向美国用户的独立站点 polymarket.us。
updates.background_en: The CFTC has argued it holds exclusive authority to regulate the growing prediction market sector rather than state-by-state regulation. Polymarket operates both an international platform and a separate US-facing venue, polymarket.us.
updates.market_impact_zh: Polymarket 是规模最大的加密预测市场，若诉讼获胜，可能迫使其进行地理封锁或削减面向美国用户的事件合约交易，从而影响平台订单簿流动性与美国用户接入。该诉讼还可能对同类预测市场平台及相关赛道代币产生外溢风险，并进一步加剧市场对“事件合约究竟适用州赌博法还是 CFTC 联邦监管”的不确定性。
updates.market_impact_en: Polymarket is the largest crypto prediction market, so a successful suit could force geofencing or curtail US-facing event-contract trading, affecting order-book liquidity and US user access on the platform. The action also carries read-across risk for rival prediction market venues and for tokens linked to the sector, while reinforcing uncertainty over whether state gambling law or federal CFTC oversight governs these products.
